Vegan Food in the United States

By Richard Prouse · Not yet checked on the ground · Updated 2026-11-17

Draft. This guide has not yet been checked on the ground. It is hidden from search engines until it is.

The United States has some of the world's strongest vegan restaurant scenes, led by Portland, Los Angeles, New York and Austin. Regional comfort food is harder: Southern greens, beans and refried beans are often cooked with pork, lard or chicken stock.

How easyEasy in big cities
Word for veganvegan
Try firstA bean burrito in California, ordered without cheese or sour cream

Traditional dishes in the United States that are vegan or can be

  • Bean burrito

    Bean burrito

    Ask for it vegan

    Ask for no cheese or sour cream and beans without lard.

  • Succotash

    Succotash

    Ask for it vegan

    Corn and lima beans; often finished with butter.

  • Collard greens

    Collard greens

    Ask for it vegan

    Traditionally cooked with smoked pork. Many restaurants now offer a vegan version.

  • Three-bean chili

    Bean chili

    Usually vegan: check

    Vegetarian chili is common; check toppings.

  • Peanut butter and jelly sandwich

    PB&J

    Vegan by tradition

    Usually vegan; some bread contains milk or honey.

What to watch for in the United States

  • Ham hock or bacon in collard greens and beans
  • Lard in refried beans and tortillas
  • Chicken stock in rice and soups
  • Butter on grilled vegetables and bread

How to ask for vegan food in English

Show this to your server, or print it:

I'm vegan: no meat, fish, eggs, dairy or honey. Is this cooked in butter, lard or chicken stock?

Why the United States

The United States is the number 3 most-visited country in the world, with 72.4 million international arrivals in 2024 (UN Tourism).
